I fit a regression discontinuity at age 21 using the 26 age groups between 20 and 22 years. The model had a jump at 21 and separate slopes on each side of the cutoff. It estimates that mortality from all causes rises by about 9.75 deaths at age 21.

I also fitted a version with a single common slope. It gave the same jump of 9.75.

ANSWER: 9.75
